ctx.x: They -- but it would be nice if like -- Stan Getz had the thing going for him, man, like, he would go play one gig, then he'd have two days off. He'd play another gig, there'd be 3 days off. And the guy would still be getting paid. That was nice.
How'd he manage to do that?
